events.body:
The driver cancelled this trip and the app reason recorded was rider_no_show [F4], so the fee stands only if every NS-1 condition holds; otherwise the fee is voided under NS-2. Arrival is established: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 09:53:15, 40 m from the pickup point, with a closest approach of 37 m, so condition (i) (arrival confirmed within 200 m) is met [F7][F1][NS-1].

The GPS record also shows continuous presence at the pickup (stationary 09:53:15–09:59:45), so condition (iv) is not in issue [F3][NS-1].

Condition (iii) fails outright. Before cancelling at 09:59:45 the driver sent 0 in-app messages and made 0 in-app calls [F5], and the chat record contains no messages at all between rider and driver [F10]. NS-1 requires at least one in-app message AND at least one in-app call before cancelling, so the condition is not satisfied [F5][NS-1].

Because a NS-1 condition fails, the fee is voided and the rider is not charged: refund_full of the $5.00 fee on record [F8][NS-2]. The driver's written statement that he pressed "I'm Here" and waited more than 5 minutes [F11] matches the parts of the record that are sufficient, but it cannot supply the missing contact attempts, and the rider's complaint that he was never messaged or called is confirmed by the timeline [F5][F10]. No fake arrival confirmation exists — the tap was made 40 m from the pickup [F7], so no flag_account is triggered under NS-2. Neither profile fact decides anything here [F15][F16][NS-2].
